content: Kuaguliwa kwaka Balunaba na Sauli

Kwaka bandu ba bunhobale Kilisitu buku Antiokia kwakabi na bandu bangi bababi alota baka Sapanga na aka abola, nkati jabu jwabi Balunaba, Simoni jobunkema Nzilu, Lukio juku Kilene, Manaeni jojabi jukoli nu nkolongu Helodi, na Sauli.
Pababia buntende Bambu ulumbi koni apungiki kula posu, Loho jaka Sapanga japwaga, “Mmekila Balunaba na Sauli pulutengu ndaba jilihengu lenaakemi.”
Henu, baada juku nndoba Sapanga nuku punga kula posu, baabekila maboku, nakaaleka ayetuana.
Sauli na Balunaba alandi ku Kipulo
Henu, Loho jaka Sapanga pajaatuma pee Balunaba na Sauli, bajenda ku Selukia, nukuhuma kola bakwela sitima mbaki ku kilwa juku Kupulo.
Pabahika ku Musi uku Salami, balandi lilobi laka Sapanga munyumba jukuketangane Ayaudi. Yohana jobunkema Maluko jabi mundu jakaajangati.
Bajenda kuhuma upandi gumwa gwa kilwa mbaki ku Papo, upandi gongi, na kola bunketani unhabi jumu Nyahudi jobunkema Bali Yesu jojulikopaki jombi mlota waka Sapanga.
Hoju jabi nkosi waka Seligio Pauli, nkolongu wa kilwa sela, jojwabii mundu jwana malangu ngamaa. Seligio Pauli jaakema Balunaba na Sauli ili jujogwana lilobi laka Sapanga.
Lakini nhabi jola, jobunkema kukigiliki Elima, jalenga kwaapenga Balunaba na Sauli ili nkolongu jwa kilwa jola jwing'anambuka nukutumbuli kunhobale Kilisitu.
Henu, Sauli jobunkema liina lengi Pauli, koni jutweli Loho jaka Sapanga, antupila mihu nduuu nhabi jola,
japwaga, “Wamwana waka lijobi weapa, weapa wumbaja wa kila sindu sa asapi, ngale ukotoka hata mala jimu kung'anambu ndela yaka Bambu yeinyokiki kuba yisoli!

Enu, kuboku kwaka Bambu kwibia panani jaku. Wibia wanga linga ngaguwesi kabee kugubona unang'anu wa lyoba kwa muda.” Apalapa kila sindu jukibona ngati likongobu na lwii, jatumbulia kupapaa koni na koni kuntaputa mundu jukunkamu kuboku ili anndongua.
Nkolongu jwa kilwa jola pajwabona gala, anng'anambukiya Sapanga nakuba mpwasi, jasangi ngamaa mabole gaka Bambu gajajowini.
Balunaba na Pauli ku musi uku Antiokia gogubii ku Pisidia
Pauli naajaki bakwela sitima kuhuma ku Papo bahika ku Peliga musi huku Pamfilia, lakini Yohana jaaleka, nuku kelabuka ku Yelusalemu.
Lakini bombi baendalia kujenda kuhuma ku Peliga mbaki kumusi uku Antiokia juku Pisidia. Lisoba lu Kupomulela bajingala mu nyumba jukuketangane Ayaudi, nukutama.

Pabajomula kusoma kitabu sa malagalaki na maandiku ga alota, aka kilongosi ba nyumba jukuketangane Ayaudi buntuma mundu kwabu, nakaapwagi, “Alongu bito ana mmbi nililobi lokapi lakaapwagi bandu ili biikata tamaa, mpwagaje.”
Ndienu, Pauli jwatenda kujema nakaponge kuboku, nakaapwagi, “Mwabandu buku Izilaeli na mwaboka mwemundumbali Sapanga, nnzowania.
Sapanga wa bandu haba buku Izilaeli baagula aka hoku bitu, nakaajangati abia bingi ngamaa pababi ku Misili. Sapanga jaaboa kola kwa makili gaki makolongu.
Sapanga jaainakali yaka alubaini pababi kulukoba.
Najombi baada jakaakoma bandu ba makabila saba ga ndema juku Kaanani nakaapeke bandu babu ili ndema heji jibia jabu.
Yapeta yaka miya nne na hamusine. “Ndienu jaapekia bandu bukutemu baalongua mbaki kipindi saka Samweli Mlota waka Sapanga.
Ndienu bandu baloba apata bambo nkolongu, ndi Sapanga jaapekia Sauli, mwana waka Kishi julikabila laka Benyamini, jojwabi bambo nkolongu kwa yaka makomi nsesi.

Baada jukummboa Sauli ubambu ukolongu, jwaapekia Daudi kuba bambu nkolongu wabu. Sapanga anndongalia koni jupwaga, ‘Nummbweni Daudi mwana waka Yese, jojuulengani mwoju wangu jojwihenga kila senipala.’
Kuhuma mukilongu saki mundu hoju, Sapanga, ngati hejutulagila, jwaapelakia bandu buku Izilaeli nkombosi, ndi Yesu.
Kabula jukuhika kwaka Yesu, Yohana anndonguli koni jaalandi bandu boti buku Izilaeli ajetakia mahakau nukugaleka nukubatiswa.”

“Yohana pajabi jujomule malobi gaki jwaapwagila bandu, ‘Nhwasali nepani nanyane? Nepani nga jomundendalela. Nnzoaniya, j ojuhika munyuma jangu nepani hata nepani ngase ndakiwa kubopo ngoji yi ilatu yaki.’
“Mwalongu bangu, mwabandu bulukolu lwaka Ibulahimu, na mwabangi mwaboha mwemundumbali Sapanga! Lijambu lendenu lu ukombosi lihikiti ndaba jitu twepani.

Ndaba bandu buku Yelusalemu na akolongu babu ngasebummanya ana jombi nkombosi, wala ngasebaeliwi malobi gaka alota baka Sapanga gaasoma kila Lisoba lu Kupomulela. Lakini bugutenda ulota hogu gutimia pabung'alisa Yesu nukunkoma.
Ngase bapatiki ndela jukunkome, bundoba pee Pilatu jwaalekila bunkoma.
Pabajomula kutenda goka gagumpwaga mu maandiku gikitabu, bunhulua punsalaba nukunhyelale pilitenge.
Lakini Sapanga anhyoa kuhuma kubandu baawi.
Najombi masoba gingi, jaapitila bajwabii nabu tumbuka ku Galilaya mbaka ku Yelusalemu. Haba ndi sajenu baalongalee majambu gaki kwa bandu buku Izilaeli.
Natwepani tuhikiki pambani kunndete Lijambu la Amboni, lijambu lejaalagila Sapanga aka hoku bitu kwaatende,
juhamwi kututende twepani twaka kibeleku sabu paanhyoa Yesu kuhuma kwa bandu baawi. Ngati healembiki mu kitabu sa zabuli japili,

content.text: ‘Weapa wa Mwanawango,
nepani lelenu ndei kukubeleka.’ ”
Kabee Sapanga heanhyoa kuhuma kwa bandu baawi
ili jwiibole mulitenge, jwapwaga ana,
“Naakupekia hindu ya sapi na yasakaka yenundagila Daudi.”
Na mu maandiku gangi ga Zabuli japwaga,
“Ngaunndeki waa Sapi waku jola jubola.”
“Ndaba, Daudi mweni pajajomula lihengu laki leampekia Sapanga mumasoba gaki na kabee jwawi nukuntaga pambipi na aseja ajaki na nhyega jaki jabohile.
Lakini Sapanga anhyoa kuhuma kwa bandu baawi na ngasejwabohile.
Henu, mmanya mwaalonguba, kupete ndela jaka mundu hoju lijambu lukulekakewa mahakahu bililandi kwinu kupete indela jaka Yesu,
na kila mundu joanhobale Yesu julekakewa mahakau gaki goka, lijambu ale ngalaka wesikini kupete malagalaki gaka Musa.
Nala nzepa, ili gampata gagabi apwagiki alota baka Sapanga:
‘Nzogwana mwanganya mwendongama bandu bangi,
Nsangia nunhobila kola!
Ndaba niihenga lihengu mumasoba ginu,
lihengu lelule nga mulihobale hata na mundu jumpwagi.’ ”
Pauli na Balunaba pababia apita mu Nyumba jukuketangane Ayaudi, bandu bala baakokiki ahika kabee Lisoba lu Kupomulela lengi lelahika, ili alongila nunkani majambuge haga.

Pabajomula kulongalane, Ayaudi bingi pamu na bandu bandema yengi bababi bijijetaki ndela jukunhobale Sapanga ja Ayaudi nabombi bumpwata Pauli na Balunaba. Nabombi balongii nabu, nakaa pwagi aendalia kutama sukutegeme wamboni waka Sapanga.

content: Lisoba lu Kupomulela helahika, kalibu kila mundu pamusi pala jahika kujogwane lilobi laka Bambu.
Ayaudi pabuubona nsambi wa bandu babona wipu, bapenga kila sejapwaga Pauli nukuntondoo.

Hataela, Pauli na Balunaba baalongila kwamakili ngani bapwaga, “Kwabi lasima lilobi laka Sapanga lunhikila mwanganya hoti, henu ndaba mutei kulikana nukulibona mwabe ngasempala womi wamasoba goti, henu, tutenda kunndeka nakaajende bandu banga Ayaudi.”
Ndaba bambu jutulagalakia ana:

content.text: “ ‘Nukubei weapa ubia unang'anu kwabandu ba ndema yengi,
ili waaletila bandu ukombosi pandema poti.’ ”

content: Bandu banga Ayaudi pabajoana haga batenda kutogule, bilimbalia lilobi laka Sapanga, na boka bababi ahaguliwi kuujopa womi wa masoba goka, babia henu ba bunhobale Kilisitu.
Lilobi laka Sapanga laheni kila pandu pa ndema pala.
Ayaudi baamua kwakwelake aka mbomba babunndumbali Sapanga na bana mali gingi naakanalomi baamanyikini pa musi pala. Batumbulia kwaang'alisa Pauli na Balunaba na kwaabenga pa musi jabu.
Ndipala Pauli na Balunaba bakung'unda luhombi mumagolu gabu kwalangi ngasebaatendi sape, nukujenda ku Ikonia.
Ila pee bandu ba bunhobale Kilisitu bababii ku Antiokia babii atweli ndogule na Loho jaka Sapanga.
